description: Narrow, scientifically conservative bibliographic retrieval / normalization / deterministic dedupe / bibliographic verification. For v1: multi-source (Crossref, OpenAlex) discovery + identity verification. It does NOT rank papers by scientific importance, does NOT judge relevance/quality/gaps, and does NOT perform literature-review synthesis. Metadata verified != scientifically valid paper; DOI exists != source supports a research claim.

references.name: Crossref REST API (metadata from member/trusted deposits; field completeness varies; not an absolute field-truth oracle)

methodology.note: retrieval rigor + bibliographic identity discipline. Evidence reconciliation, not a hardcoded source winner.

verification.evidence: External reference workflow (brycewang-stanford/Auto-Empirical-Research-Skills). Not locally runnable here; not represented as locally available. No local benchmark evidence.

M1 implementation + M2 real-bibliographic benchmark + frozen adversarial suite + M3 workflow/resolver/provenance integration + M4 closure evidence. Real Crossref/OpenAlex clients (Node built-in fetch; DI seam for tests); deterministic normalize/dedupe/bibliographic-verify mechanics. DEMONSTRATED: real Crossref/OpenAlex adapters implemented; live attempts executed and the resulting source failures (source_unavailable/transport) recorded honestly; independent authoritative ground truth (NBER/QJE/JSTOR) frozen; deterministic source-shaped replay (ground_truth_derived_source_shaped_replay); adversarial normalization/dedupe/verification + source-degradation matrix; strict workflow/resolver/role/provenance integration; provenance/tamper resistance; role/resolver behavior. NOT DEMONSTRATED: successful live Crossref retrieval; successful live OpenAlex retrieval; actual live multi-source reconciliation; tested maturity. Preferred closure wording: "independently grounded multi-source-shaped replay benchmark passed; live transport evidence incomplete." Status = experimental (strict rule: no tested/verified without successful live crossref+openalex). LIVE_EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE. No review synthesis, no fuzzy title/LLM judgment, no public artifact-schema change, no Core special case.
